semiconductor_relevance: Low — SWCC Corporation primarily focuses on manufacturing wires and cables, which are not directly relevant to semiconductor production.
summary: SWCC Corporation is a leading manufacturer of electric wires and cables in Japan, established in 1936. While they produce high-performance ultra-fine flat wire, their core business does not directly align with semiconductor manufacturing or supply.

regional_presence.Japan: SWCC Corporation is the third largest wire and cable manufacturer in Japan, supplying products globally.
